description: Encryption layers Task 4 (lane H): migration players_contact_sealed adds three columns to players (phone_sealed, phone_index, phone_index_kid), all NULL, a format check, a unique index on phone_index for verified live accounts, and a trigger that clears the three when phone_e164 changes without a new sealing. Then scripts/pii/backfill-phone.mjs fills the three columns for every account that has a phone number. Additive: phone, phone_e164 and phone_verified_at must not change for anyone; no row, account, email, session, role or membership may change. Live traffic keeps writing while the migration and the backfill run, so the tables below are listed as volatile.

allowChangedColumns.reason: The intended change: the backfill writes the sealed copy of each account's existing phone number (NULL before). Applies when the 'before' snapshot is taken after the migration.
The intended change: the backfill writes the keyed index of each account's existing phone number (NULL before).
The intended change: the backfill records which index key made phone_index (NULL before).
